title: Telekinesis Mod
description: A lightweight mod that adds a Telekinesis Rod to move mobs and entities.
body:
![telekinesis title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c291631a239a6ab6db6e905fae644cf05b01be3c.png)

# **⚡ Overview**
Have you ever wanted to move a villager or a cow without the hassle of boats and leads? 

**Telekinesis** introduces a powerful magical rod that allows players to pick up, hold, and move entities and blocks from a distance.

**​Note:** This mod is required on both the Client and the Server. Players must have the mod installed to see the custom rod textures and use the keybindings (like the B key). 

# **🪄 Features**
The **Telekinesis Rod** is a powerful tool designed for effortless manipulation:

- **Grab & Move:** Right-click any **entity or block** to "grab" it and move it through the air.
- **Precision Building:** Use it to place blocks in hard-to-reach places or rearrange your base with ease.


# **🎮 How to Use**
Follow these simple steps to master your telekinetic powers:

- **Lock the Target:** Aim at a mob or a block and **Right-Click** to lock onto it.
- **Move:** Move your mouse to change the position of the mob or block in the world.
- **Set Position:** Once you are satisfied with the location, press **`B`** to fix the mob/block in its new place.

# **🛠️ Crafting Recipe**
![telekinesis craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/dce59411419a8fddc2cba0ea5ec4cfb505efec26.png)

The rod can be crafted using standard materials in the crafting table.

# **⚙️ Technical Details**
- **Modloader:** Forge
- **Version:** 1.20.1
- **Type:** Client & Server Side

# **📌 Notice:**
There is a bug where the telekinesis effects keep working on entities even if the rod is not in your hand or inventory. Unfortunately, the source code files were lost, so I am unable to patch this at the moment. Just think of it as an extra "magical feature"! 😉
